Ambitious - to break ground to help our customers enjoy a better retirement.

Personal - going above and beyond to offer exceptional service.
Integrity - honest, true and transparent in all our relationships.
Responsive - whatever the challenge we'll deliver the right result.
Expert - experts in our field, our thirst for knowledge never stops

- Simply Health
- Life Assurance

As well as being an experienced purchase ledger clerk, you will also be organised, be a good communicator and be able to work on your own initiative.

In return you will receive a competitive salary, have the option to work two days from home and three days in the office, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, private healthcare (after probationary) and free on site parking.

If you are an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk looking for a new challenge, please apply to Tammy Smith now for an immediate interview.
